title: A relative Euclidean thickening
summary: For a finite CW pair $(K,L)$, we show how to construct a Poincaré triad $(P;\partial_0 P,\partial_1 P)$ and a weak homotopy equivalence $(K,L) \overset{{}_\sim}\to (P,\partial_0 P)$. Furthermore, the Poincaré pair $(P,\partial P)$ has a trivial Spivak normal fibration. The proof is homotopy-theoretic. We also prove a uniqueness result.
